one_line: A fixed plane from each facade
tooltip: Removes everything above a plane at a fixed angle from each facade.
protects_hint: Facades the angle is measured from, such as neighbouring facades.

one_line: Direct sun in a chosen period
tooltip: Keeps direct sun on the test surfaces during the hours you choose, for example 21 December, 10 to 14 h.
needs: Needs a weather file and an analysis period.
protects_hint: Facades, windows or open spaces that keep direct sun in the period.

one_line: Sun and sky energy over a season
tooltip: Keeps the sun and sky energy that reaches the surfaces over the period.
needs: Needs a weather file and an analysis period.
protects_hint: Roofs or facades that collect sun and sky energy, for example for solar panels.

one_line: Sun in hours that need heating
tooltip: Like solar energy, counting only hours cold enough to need heating.
needs: Needs a weather file and an analysis period.
protects_hint: Facades or windows that gain useful heat from the sun.

tooltip: Keeps the view of an overcast sky, for daylight rules and visual comfort.
protects_hint: Windows or facades that need daylight.

one_line: View of the cold night sky
tooltip: Keeps a flat roof's view of the cold night sky. Experimental; assumes horizontal test surfaces.
protects_hint: Flat roofs that cool toward the night sky.
